items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Whenever he couldn't play with this fellow, we hired anybody who we couldn't get. That's the way, that's how I come to play with some of that fellow... Was it Willie Joseph? ... Not fancy. But this fellow right there, he was a good reader. He was the one who used to arrange all our music.

ctx.x: He's still playing. He's only 85. Huh? No, he's still. 86. He's still here. He still plays bass in New Orleans. Oh, I see. Cuts hair by day and plays bass at night. Wasn't he a president?
No, and Willie Joseph. Where is he at? He's the one that should be playing that saxophone.
He passed. He passed. He passed. He was hit by a car, hit one driver. Came back from California to visit his brothers and got one of them. He was a pastor. Palleter you're talking about.
